bug_catcher.name: Bug Catcher
dialog: A Wurmple grows into a Silcoon or a Cascoon, and nobody can tell you which beforehand.
I've raised four of them now. Every single one turned out a Cascoon!

trainer.name: Jack
trainer.dialogueBefore: Bug Catcher Jack: This forest is my back garden! Want to see what I found in it?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bug Catcher Jack: My Beautifly started out as a little Wurmple. Raising it was worth every minute.

trainer.name: Briana
trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Briana: It's so gloomy under these trees! A battle will cheer me up.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Briana: I only came in for a short walk, and somehow I'm still walking. Which way is out?

trainer.name: Lindsey
trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Lindsey: I saw you coming long before you came round the bend. Shall I tell you how this ends?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Lindsey: ...That isn't the ending I saw. I must have been looking at somebody else's.

trainer.name: Elijah
trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Elijah: The trees murmur, if you listen with your mind. They told me you were on your way.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Elijah: The trees never said I'd lose. Too polite, I expect.

trainer.name: Kody
trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Kody: I come into the forest to train my mind. You turning up is part of the training.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Kody: My concentration has gone. I'll sit under a tree and start again from the beginning.

trainer.name: Rachael
trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Rachael: My Psyduck has one of its headaches. That's when its powers come out!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Rachael: Its headache has gone, and its powers went with it. Poor thing.

trainer.name: Phillip
trainer.dialogueBefore: Bug Catcher Phillip: Everybody wants a Beautifly. Not me! I raised a Dustox, and I'm proud of it.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bug Catcher Phillip: My Dustox flies to the lamps every evening. Mum says it's not allowed in the kitchen.

trainer.name: Donald
trainer.dialogueBefore: Bug Catcher Donald: My Burmy dress in leaves from this very forest. Smart, aren't they?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bug Catcher Donald: Battle a Burmy in a cave or among buildings and it makes itself a new cloak. I want all three!

signs.signboard:
Eterna Forest
The old woods. Eterna City lies past their eastern edge.
signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
A thin tree in the way can be felled with Cut. Outside battle, it takes the Badge of Eterna City's Gym.
